name: vffcc
title: Free Claude Code fit

source.title: Alishahryar1/free-claude-code
source.claim: 50 ToS-friendly providers, BYOK, local proxy on :8082; not affiliated with Anthropic

hqFact: FCC does not reduce Cursor Cloud Agent usage. This pack is a map + locks, not an install.

clients.name: Claude Code
clients.note: Owner Mac only. Points ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at localhost. Does not feed Cursor Cloud.

clients.name: OpenCode
clients.note: Second local client if lead seat prefers it over Claude Code. Pick one.

clients.name: Codex
clients.note: Needs ChatGPT connect or OpenAI path. Orchestra already opens ChatGPT in the browser.

clients.name: Pi / Cline / Hermes / DeepSeek Harness / Grok Build / Muse / Aider
clients.note: vfe2b second-office lock. Do not install the whole client list.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM
providers.note: FCC default. Free key at build.nvidia.com. Owner machine only.

providers.name: Groq
providers.note: Published free tier. Fast drafts. Owner machine only.

providers.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini)
providers.note: Already an orchestra desk in the browser. Separate key if used as FCC backend.

providers.name: OpenRouter free
providers.note: Example model open_router/openrouter/free. Quality varies. Owner machine only.

providers.name: OpenAI / ChatGPT subscription
providers.note: Orchestra already opens ChatGPT. Do not duplicate as an HQ proxy.

providers.name: Ollama / LM Studio / llama.cpp
providers.note: Truly local weights. Needs RAM/GPU on the owner Mac. Lead seat decides.

providers.name: xAI (Grok API)
providers.note: Grok Bot is the live sender. Do not mix xAI keys into HQ or FCC.

providers.name: Azure OpenAI / Amazon Bedrock / Vertex AI
providers.note: Enterprise cloud. Not the Sderot office.

providers.name: Discord / Telegram / voice notes
providers.note: HQ does not send. Human WhatsApp 050-2517000.

providers.name: DeepSeek / Mistral / Qwen / Together / Kimi / MiniMax / Z.ai / Hugging Face / …
providers.note: More BYOK names in the FCC README. Do not add from HQ. Owner picks one free key first.
